title: QRiate+ landing page: choose the composition
question: The visual world is already settled (Sarlotte, Raleway, the De Sign Plus tokens, the QRiate+ palette). This choice is composition: how the page is arranged and what it proves in the first viewport. The roll dealt three. Lock one.

options.label: The Reprint Quote
options.lineage: a Nigerian print-shop job docket and quotation sheet
options.thesis: The page is the reprint bill you never have to pay again.
options.viewport: A full-bleed quotation docket: ruled line items for reprinting a label run, the naira total struck through in coral, and directly beneath it one line reading 'Change the destination instead — no reprint'. The sign-up action is the docket's authorisation stamp, bottom right where a signature goes.
options.risk: Leads with cost rather than capability, and every figure on the docket is illustrative, so it has to be labelled as such or it reads as an invented claim.

options.label: The Constant Code
options.lineage: a printed specimen pinned under glass while the page moves past it
options.thesis: One QR symbol, pinned and never redrawn, while every destination under it changes.
options.viewport: A single real QR symbol locked at full height on the left two-fifths, physically unchanged for the entire scroll. To its right the destination log: dated rows swapping from a launch page to a menu to a catalogue, the newest one live. The paste-a-destination field and the sign-up action sit directly under the symbol, so the action is in the mechanism.
options.risk: A pinned object can read as a static illustration; the proof collapses unless the destinations visibly change against it.

options.label: The Switchboard
options.lineage: a telephone patch panel: printed objects on one side, destinations on the other
options.thesis: Printed things on one side, destinations on the other, and cables you re-patch without touching the print.
options.viewport: A full-width enamelled patch field. Left: engraved jacks for real printed things — label, menu card, gift box, banner. Right: destination jacks. Braided cables arc between them, one held mid-move with its old jack still warm. The primary action is the panel's authorisation plate under the field.
options.risk: The metaphor outruns the product the moment the cables do not actually re-point anything; it also asks the most of a phone screen.
